# Codes and documents

The vector format plugins (`UltraCanvasCDRElement`, `UltraCanvasEPSElement`,
`UltraCanvasXARElement`) are **not** in these tables on purpose: they are
decoders behind `UltraCanvasVectorElement` and `UltraCanvasImageElement`, which
are what an application reaches for. An SVG has no element of its own either:
`UltraCanvasImageElement` shows it (through librsvg, or the Vector plugin's
reader where libvips has no SVG loader). Same for
the LaTeX and STL elements, listed under *Text, images and media* above.

## Elements

| Element | What it is for | Callbacks |
|---|---|---|
| [`UltraCanvasBarcodeElement`](../Elements/UltraCanvasBarcodeElement.md) | A 1D barcode (EAN, UPC, Code 39/128, ITF, Codabar …) with its human-readable line | `onError`, `onEncoded`, `onClick` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasCDRElement`](../Elements/UltraCanvasCDRElement.md) |  | `onPageChanged`, `onLoadError`, `onLoadComplete` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasEPSElement`](../Elements/UltraCanvasEPSElement.md) |  | (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasMarkdownDisplay`](../Elements/UltraCanvasMarkdownDisplay.md) | Markdown rendered as a standalone display (`UltraCanvasTextArea`'s Markdown mode is the editable route) | `SetLinkClickCallback`, `SetTextSelectedCallback`, `SetScrollChangedCallback` (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasPDFView`](../Elements/UltraCanvasPDFView.md) | A PDF on its own, with thumbnail strip, zoom and search-hit overlay (`UltraCanvasMediaViewer` embeds this for `.pdf`) | `onPageChanged`, `onSearchResults`, `onError`, `onDocumentChanged`, `onZoomChanged`, `onActiveHitChanged`, `onImageExtracted`, `onSelectionChanged` … (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasQRCode`](../Elements/UltraCanvasQRCode.md) | A QR code | (+5 inherited) |
| [`UltraCanvasXARElement`](../Elements/UltraCanvasXARElement.md) |  | `onPageChanged` (+5 inherited) |
